---
title: "Rental Service Architecture Training"
---

This course uses an executable rental platform to study distributed systems,
NoSQL, cloud-native delivery, and event-driven architecture. It targets
graduate computer science students and software professionals.

## Active modules

1. [Architectural decomposition and microservices](modules/01-architectural-decomposition/slides.qmd)
2. [Synchronous communication with REST and gRPC](modules/02-synchronous-communication/slides.qmd)
3. [Distributed systems patterns](modules/03-distributed-systems-patterns/slides.qmd)
4. [Containers and Docker Compose](modules/04-containers-compose/slides.qmd)
5. [Cloud-native delivery](modules/05-cloud-native-delivery/slides.qmd)
6. [Kubernetes fundamentals](modules/06-kubernetes-fundamentals/slides.qmd)
7. [NoSQL foundations](modules/07-nosql-foundations/slides.qmd)
8. [Redis data and messaging](modules/08-redis-data-messaging/slides.qmd)
9. [Event-driven architecture with Redis Lists](modules/09-event-driven-lists/slides.qmd)
10. [Consumer decoupling and application extensions](modules/10-consumer-decoupling/slides.qmd)
11. [Operability and architectural evaluation](modules/11-operability-evaluation/slides.qmd)

Each module links to its lab from the final slide.

## Planned modules

[Redis Streams and CQRS roadmap](roadmap.qmd) describes the future software
increments and their associated training modules. They are intentionally not
part of the rendered course yet.

## Local rendering

```bash
quarto preview training
```

The material remains editable while classroom evaluation is in progress.
